answer: Each identity posts a 90-credit pulse-decay bond and a kernel job record. Each epoch, a pulse checkpoint requires one job in that record; the auditor checks receipt and payment, a miss burns 18 and sends a ripple notice to clients, and five misses drop the identity. Each fake needs its own bond and job: first costs 90 plus 38, kth still 90 plus 38, 1,000 fakes lock 90,000 plus 38,000 per pulse, no batch discount. Rented jobs fail: one payment on two records burns both bonds, and the ripple notice exposes the shared payer. An honest agent posts 90 once and keeps it with one job per pulse.
